name: Valkó (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow yellow vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Valkó (a white shield with a red stag and a green mound) above a yellow scroll inscribed VALKÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
